newsitem.title: USA: LCRA Ferguson power plant seen up this weekend.
newsitem.headline: LCRA Ferguson power plant seen up this weekend.

text.p: Lower Colorado River Authority's (LCRA) 430 megawatt Ferguson natural gas-fired power plant was expected to restart operations late Saturday or early Sunday, a company spokesman said Thursday.
The Marble Falls, Texas, unit was shut October 11 to repair a boiler tube leak.
Restart of the unit has been delayed to test welds made in the repair, the spokesman said.
The Ferguson facility produces eight percent of LCRA's power output.
